unjoined_vocab_tokenizer.py + spm_train_functions.get_user_defined_symbols — the 1944-token vocabulary, reproduced exactly: 1,299 user-defined + 645 unjoined = 1,944 = config.vocab_size

mainZip.whyTheInputContractMatters: mask_locations = (target track, every measure in the window) is literally the Tier B arranger task: given the rest of the arrangement, write this part. CA2's fine-tuned objective is our objective.

pinnedChecksumsSha256.note: These are the values the Modal image and the adapter must verify before loading. A mismatch is not the model.

residualsNamed: 18 of 237 Mutopia composer rows carry post-1926 death dates; PD-by-age does not apply to them and the basis is the composer's/arranger's own CC-BY release on Mutopia.

HetzlersFakebook contributed files under permission; fake books are jazz-standard lead sheets, some still in copyright. Share is tiny (2 links of ~2,500) and the author states only 'allowable' files were used, but it is the one contributor whose repertoire is not PD by nature.

'Marked as being in the public domain' relies on the source sites' marking — the same structural reliance PDMX had before its no_license_conflict filter. Mutopia's curation is stricter than MuseScore's, which is why this is treated as cleared rather than unknown.
whyThisMattersForTheFromScratchDecision: This is the first candidate that is simultaneously (a) our exact task — multi-track MIDI infilling with fine-grained controls, (b) a standard HF T5 that runs without REAPER, and (c) trained on a corpus where the underlying works are cleared by age or by synthesis. Its weakness is exactly the corpus's strength: it has learned classical/early idiom and almost nothing else, and PDMX (also mostly classical solo) would not broaden that. The tournament will show whether its infilling competence transfers to pop/Mizrahi arrangement; the corpus says not to expect it to.
